session_read: Sunday 2026-08-16. Nothing traded since Friday's close, so every number here is Saturday's number -- the book has not moved, and saying otherwise would be invention. What did move is the evidence around it. CXMT is now projected to end 2026 within 25k wafer-starts of Micron's DRAM capacity, with share at 8% against 3% a year ago; the counter-scale matters and is stated: wafer starts are not bits, and node density and yield still trail. That lands on 15.53% of equity. China's first domestic immersion DUV tools reportedly begin shipping this month -- 5 units against ASML's 131, so the timing is newly concrete and the magnitude is unchanged. The desk's own position is the more uncomfortable finding: sentiment 82.9 EXTREME GREED, VIX near a 52-week low, NDX RSI 73, ten names over their ATR caps, aggregate risk 14.4% against a 10% ceiling -- and $12.25 of cash against a 5-15% band, into NVDA's print on 08-26 at 7.72% weight. Six trims sit open and unactioned to fix exactly that. This run ended degraded: the account hit its monthly spend limit mid-sweep, so the thesis and strategist stages did not run and no new proposals were written.
